sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/362 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place for PlaceId 362, search/grid for facility 508 Mary Jane Thurston Campground, search/details for all 39 campsites on 2027-06-15, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Electric sites $35 a night; the 4 premium electric sites with water $39 (tent-only walk-in sites $29). Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices for June 2027 nights, read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all 39 Mary Jane Thurston campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric Rate 35.00, Campsite Premium Electric 39.00, Campsite Tent Only 29.00, Fee 6.50), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/mary-jane-thurston-state-park-campground ('23 electric sites have 30-amp service; 4 are premium sites with electric and water hook-up') + ReserveOhio search/details (Electricity Hookup '30' on all 23 electric sites), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 23 electric RV sites (19 standard, 4 premium with water), asphalt pads 12 x 50 ft, two of them pull-through (8 and 17). The other 16 sites (24-39) are tent-only, non-electric, with parking away from the site.

sites.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/mary-jane-thurston-state-park-campground ('16 sites are designated for tent camping', '23 electric sites') + ReserveOhio search/details (Maximum Camping Unit Length 50, Pad Size '12 x 50', PullInTypeName), read 2026-10-30

values.note: An outdoor shower in the campground; full showers for registered campers are at the marina. Potable fill station and dump station near the park office.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/mary-jane-thurston-state-park-campground ('Latrines and restrooms are located nearby', 'Potable fill station and dump station near the park office', 'An outdoor shower is located in the campground. Showers are available to registered campers located at the marina'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservations up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727; every campsite is web-bookable, with a 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/mary-jane-thurston-state-park-campground ('Reservations may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14, CheckInStarts 15:00, CheckOutTime 13:00 on every campsite), read 2026-10-30

note: Electric riverfront sites front the Maumee River (e.g. pull-through site 8). --Claude
summary: Fees confirmed at $35 base and raised high to the $39 premium electric+water sites; added 30-amp electric (water at the 4 premium sites), 23 RV sites to 50 ft with 2 pull-throughs, showers/flush+latrine toilets/fill station/dump, ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window and 14-night max. Pin is 54 m from the RV sites' centre (fine). Season not stated for the campground. Note: dropped the premium-site clause now in hookups/sites.
